title: Response header built from input (php) — review required
description: A php response call sets a header from assembled parts: header("X-N: " . $_GET['n']). CRLF sequences in untrusted input split the response and inject headers or body bytes. This lexical rule flags the assembly; the reviewer confirms the value is validated.
remediation: Validate the value against a token-charset allowlist (no CR/LF, expected charset) before setting the header.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: any assembled header matches; modern frameworks often reject CRLF, which the reviewer should confirm.
